title: Why Bitcoin’s Liquidity Advantage Matters as Institutions Move In
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Why Bitcoin’s Liquidity Advantage Matters as Institutions Move In SALT Lending CEO Shawn Owen explains why Bitcoin’s portability gives it an advantage over traditional assets and why institutional adoption may only be getting started. This post Why Bitcoin’s Liquidity Advantage Matters as Institutions Move In first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Josh Plischke .
